title: Make the task-sync integration tests pass on Windows: path expectations built with forward slashes never match the paths the product prints
outcome: Make the task-sync integration tests pass on Windows: path expectations built with forward slashes never match the paths the product prints
acceptance: `cargo test --test task_sync_refusal_codes` passes on Windows, including boundaries::task_sync_json_file_refusal_omits_the_plain_reading_path_context, with its assertion still checking the actual path the product reports
Every other Windows-only failure in the task_sync integration test binaries found by the inventory run is fixed or filed with its own evidence
No assertion is loosened to pass: expected paths are built the same way the product builds them, not matched more vaguely
